terms.register: vōx plērumque poētica: Verg., Ov., Hor.

phrases.latin: Quot stēllae in caelō sunt? — Innumerābilēs.
phrases.english: How many stars are in the sky? — Too many to count.

phrases.latin: macte novā virtūte, puer, sīc ītur ad astra
phrases.english: a blessing on your new-found courage, boy: that is the way to the stars
Look up: how many stars are shining!

phrases.latin: suspice caelum et numerā stēllās, sī potes
phrases.english: look up at the sky and count the stars, if you can

phrases.latin: sedēbāmus ergō in puppī simul ūniversī et lūcentia sīdera cōnsīderābāmus
phrases.english: so we all sat together on the stern and gazed at the shining stars

sources: Lewis & Short: stella · Lewis & Short: sidus
